# Pemberton Cycle Couriers - office workspace

Office drive for the courier co-operative.

- office/  issue routing and the rider onboarding pack

The routing list holds one team per issue type and is edited in place, so an issue type is never split across two teams. Rows are kept in alphabetical order of the issue type. Last reviewed 2026-07-21, reference PC-1188.
